## Triage: first touch → `domain:ui` · p3 · 2026-11-15T15:49Z

⛔ Not a claim.

The declared feed filter `changes_only` can never be offered on a `record:discussion` panel: the panel sits only on authored pages, and field-history context is filled only on synthesized pages. A declared value with no working surface (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove). p3.

Ruling-ref: maintainer 2026-11-19T00:46Z, decision card in seat repo:objectstack#5's project session, option chosen verbatim: 「A 补实现」.

Route A (enforce, ADR-0049): on an authored record page the discussion panel reads field history and offers `changes_only`, so an authored `filterMode: 'changes_only'` no longer silently reads as All. UI only: no protocol change, `Clause-②: no`; touches published `@object-ui/plugin-detail` / `@object-ui/app-shell` (changeset owed). The gap is wider than the title: the authored-page audit read never goes out (`RecordDetailView.tsx` ~:2897), so `record:discussion`, `record:chatter` and `record:activity` are all affected. Keep #30344 (no option for a reader refused the audit read) and #30122 (pairing); read only while the panel is on screen. Not measured: how much existing authored panels visibly change, and the extra read's cost; the PR measures both.
Goes to area ux-2 of seat repo:objectstack#5 (`lease:ux-2`).
